$comment: Machine-readable usage intent for cre8 design tokens. Served by the cre8-mcp list_tokens tool and read by docs/kb/tools/generate-reference.mjs. Seed and semantic tiers are listed token by token; primitive, component and legacy tiers are covered by patterns. Hand-authored: when a semantic token is added to tokens_brand.css, add it here (generate-reference fails on a semantic token with no intent).

seed.summary: The only literals in the system. Set from brand.json; every other tier derives from them.
seed.change: Edit brand.json, then pnpm tokens:build. Never hand-set in CSS except as a scoped override on a [data-cre8-theme] element.

primitive.summary: OKLCH ramps (50..950) and raw scales derived from the seeds. No meaning attached.

semantic.summary: Purpose, not colour. The tier components and app CSS should read. The only tier data-mode touches.
semantic.change: Read these in your CSS. Override one only for a deliberate, scoped exception; prefer a seed.

component.summary: One component's aliases onto semantic tokens.
component.change: Only for a genuine one-off on one component, via brand.json overrides (warned) or a scoped rule.

legacy.summary: Old --cre8-color-* names kept as aliases so existing component styles resolve.
legacy.change: Never write new code against these; use the semantic name without the color- prefix.

--cre8-seed-primary.use: the brand hue; the primary-50..950 ramp, buttons, links, focus and selection all derive from it
--cre8-seed-primary.never: hand-setting in a stylesheet; set it in brand.json so the ramps and the contrast guard follow

--cre8-seed-neutral.use: the grey family; surfaces, borders and body text derive from it, and a tinted neutral sets the brand temperature
--cre8-seed-neutral.never: hand-setting in a stylesheet; set it in brand.json so the ramps and the contrast guard follow

--cre8-seed-accent.use: the secondary brand hue; info states, visited links, highlights and charts derive from it
--cre8-seed-accent.never: hand-setting in a stylesheet; set it in brand.json so the ramps and the contrast guard follow

--cre8-seed-success.use: the success hue; positive status backgrounds, borders and text derive from it
--cre8-seed-success.never: hand-setting in a stylesheet; set it in brand.json so the ramps and the contrast guard follow

--cre8-seed-warning.use: the warning hue; caution status backgrounds, borders and icons derive from it
--cre8-seed-warning.never: hand-setting in a stylesheet; set it in brand.json so the ramps and the contrast guard follow

--cre8-seed-error.use: the error hue; destructive and invalid-state backgrounds, borders and text derive from it
--cre8-seed-error.never: hand-setting in a stylesheet; set it in brand.json so the ramps and the contrast guard follow

--cre8-seed-font.use: the body/UI font stack every typography token resolves through
--cre8-seed-font.never: hand-setting in a stylesheet; set it in brand.json so the ramps and the contrast guard follow

--cre8-seed-font-size.use: the body text size; the type scale is computed from it
--cre8-seed-font-size.never: hand-setting in a stylesheet; set it in brand.json so the ramps and the contrast guard follow

--cre8-seed-radius.use: the container corner radius; control, button and pill radii derive from it
--cre8-seed-radius.never: hand-setting in a stylesheet; set it in brand.json so the ramps and the contrast guard follow

--cre8-seed-space.use: the 1-step spacing unit; the spacing and padding scales multiply it
--cre8-seed-space.never: hand-setting in a stylesheet; set it in brand.json so the ramps and the contrast guard follow

--cre8-seed-border-width.use: the default hairline width for borders and dividers
--cre8-seed-border-width.never: hand-setting in a stylesheet; set it in brand.json so the ramps and the contrast guard follow

--cre8-bg-default.use: the page and default component surface
--cre8-bg-default.never: text or icons; use a --cre8-content-* token

--cre8-bg-default-hover.use: the hover state of a default-surface row, item or ghost control

--cre8-bg-default-active.use: the pressed/selected state of a default-surface item

--cre8-bg-subtle.use: recessed areas: wells, table stripes, sidebars, code blocks
--cre8-bg-subtle.never: the main page surface or any text

--cre8-bg-moderate.use: mid-grey fills such as track backgrounds and placeholders
--cre8-bg-moderate.never: text backgrounds; contrast with body text is not guaranteed

--cre8-bg-inverse-moderate.use: mid-grey fills on an inverse (dark) region

--cre8-bg-strong.use: high-emphasis neutral fills: tooltips, toasts, dark bands on a light page
--cre8-bg-strong.never: large page areas; pair text on it with --cre8-content-knockout

--cre8-bg-disabled.use: the fill of a disabled control

--cre8-bg-brand.use: a light brand-tinted surface behind brand content (selected nav, callouts)

--cre8-bg-brand-strong.use: the primary action fill: primary buttons, active toggles, brand bars
--cre8-bg-brand-strong.never: large page backgrounds or body-text backgrounds; text on it is --cre8-content-knockout

--cre8-bg-brand-xstrong.use: the darkest brand fill, for emphasis on or next to bg-brand-strong (headers, hero bands)

--cre8-bg-success.use: a light success background (alert, badge, row highlight)

--cre8-bg-success-strong.use: a solid success fill (filled badge, progress complete)
--cre8-bg-success-strong.never: large areas or text backgrounds without checking contrast

--cre8-bg-error.use: a light error background (inline error, alert)

--cre8-bg-error-strong.use: a solid error fill (destructive button, filled error badge)

--cre8-bg-warning-strong.use: a solid warning fill (filled warning badge)

--cre8-bg-info.use: a light informational background (info alert, tip)

--cre8-bg-info-strong.use: a solid informational fill (filled info badge)

--cre8-bg-attention.use: the surface behind an attention-state element
--cre8-bg-attention.never: status meaning; attention is emphasis, not success/error

--cre8-bg-attention-strong.use: a solid attention fill (new/featured markers, highlight chips)

--cre8-bg-opacity-transparent.use: a fully transparent fill that keeps the token chain (ghost buttons)
--cre8-bg-opacity-transparent.never: hiding content; use display or visibility

--cre8-bg-opacity-default.use: the scrim behind modals and drawers

--cre8-bg-active.use: the fill of an active/current item in a dark-on-light treatment (current tab pill)

--cre8-bg-inverse-active.use: the fill of an active item inside an inverse region

--cre8-content-default.never: text on brand-strong or strong fills; use --cre8-content-knockout

--cre8-content-subtle.use: secondary text: captions, helper text, metadata, placeholders
--cre8-content-subtle.never: body copy or anything the user must read to act; check it meets 4.5:1 where it carries meaning

--cre8-content-disabled.use: text and icons of disabled controls

--cre8-content-knockout.use: text and icons on strong fills (bg-brand-strong, bg-strong, *-strong status fills)
--cre8-content-knockout.never: text on default surfaces, where it is invisible

--cre8-content-brand.use: brand-coloured text and icons: emphasis, active nav labels
--cre8-content-brand.never: links; use --cre8-content-link so visited/hover states work

--cre8-content-brand-strong.use: higher-contrast brand text on tinted brand surfaces

--cre8-content-brand-knockout.use: brand-tinted text on dark brand fills

--cre8-content-error.never: decorative red; error colour means something is wrong

--cre8-content-warning-icon.never: warning text on light backgrounds; contrast is usually too low

--cre8-content-inverse-link.use: link text inside an inverse (dark) region

--cre8-content-inverse-link-hover.use: hovered links inside an inverse region

--cre8-content-link-focus.use: link text while focused (sits on the focus fill)
--cre8-content-link-focus.never: focus rings; the ring is a border/outline token

--cre8-content-inverse-link-focus.use: focused links inside an inverse region

--cre8-content-inverse-link-visited.use: visited links inside an inverse region

--cre8-content-inverse-link-disabled.use: disabled links inside an inverse region

--cre8-content-inverse-link-active.use: pressed links inside an inverse region

--cre8-border-default.use: default borders and dividers: cards, inputs, table rules

--cre8-border-strong.use: high-emphasis borders: input outlines that must meet 3:1, separators that must read

--cre8-border-brand.use: brand-coloured borders: selected cards, active inputs

--cre8-border-brand-subtle.use: light brand borders on tinted brand surfaces

--cre8-border-transparent.use: a transparent border that reserves space so state changes do not shift layout
--cre8-border-transparent.never: hiding borders on purpose-built borderless components

--cre8-border-active-outline.use: the focus ring / active outline on light surfaces
--cre8-border-active-outline.never: decorative borders; never remove it without a replacement

--cre8-border-inverse-active-outline.use: the focus ring / active outline inside an inverse region

--cre8-link-bg-active.use: the background of a pressed or focused link

patterns.use: a specific step of a seed ramp, only when no semantic token carries the meaning
patterns.never: component or app CSS where a semantic token exists; a ramp step does not flip with data-mode

patterns.use: gaps and padding on the space scale derived from --cre8-seed-space
patterns.never: literal px/rem spacing in component CSS

patterns.use: type scale steps derived from the typography seeds; prefer --cre8-typography-* composites
internal light/inverse indirection that data-mode remaps
patterns.never: reading or setting directly; read the semantic token instead

patterns.use: a complete text style (family, size, weight, line height) for one typographic role
nothing new; kept so existing component styles resolve
patterns.never: new code; drop the color- prefix to get the semantic name

patterns.use: restyling one component in a scoped one-off
patterns.never: brand-wide changes; change a seed so every component follows
